name: Exp_Sar_Tm_Plus
summary: This EA trades based on the Parabolic SAR indicator with time filtering and additional enhancements. It enters positions when the SAR reverses direction, confirming a trend change, and uses time-based session filters to restrict trading to specific hours. The 'Plus' variant likely adds trailing stops, money management, or multi-confirmation logic on top of the base SAR strategy.
summary_zh: 该EA基于抛物线SAR指标进行交易，并加入时间过滤和增强功能。当SAR方向反转确认趋势变化时入场，同时使用时段过滤限制交易时间。Plus版本在基础SAR策略上可能增加了追踪止损、资金管理或多重确认逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心基于Parabolic SAR指标的转向信号，当SAR从价格上方转到下方时做多，反之做空。入场条件为SAR方向反转确认趋势启动，可能结合时间过滤器仅在指定交易时段开仓。出场条件包括SAR再次反转、固定止损止盈或追踪止损机制。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算。资金管理方面，Plus版本可能加入了风险百分比控制和最大持仓限制。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪型，依赖SAR指标捕捉趋势启动点，但SAR在震荡行情中容易产生频繁假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core relies on Parabolic SAR reversal signals, going long when SAR flips from above to below price and short on the opposite. Entry conditions require SAR direction reversal to confirm trend initiation, combined with a time filter that restricts trading to designated sessions. Exit conditions include SAR re-reversal, fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, or a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing may use fixed lots or dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management in the Plus variant likely incorporates risk percentage control and maximum position limits. The overall approach is a classic trend-following system dependent on SAR to capture trend onset points, though SAR tends to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to identify its orders

pros: SAR指标逻辑清晰，信号明确无歧义，适合机械化执行
时间过滤功能可有效避开低流动性时段和重大新闻时段，减少滑点和假信号
Plus版本增加了止损止盈和追踪止损，风险控制比基础版更完善
pros_en: SAR indicator logic is clear and unambiguous, well-suited for systematic execution
Time filtering effectively avoids low-liquidity sessions and major news events, reducing slippage and false signals
The Plus variant adds stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop for better risk control than the base version
cons: Parabolic SAR在震荡行情中频繁反转，产生大量假信号导致连续亏损
依赖单一指标缺乏多维度确认，趋势识别可靠性有限
固定手数仓位管理无法根据市场波动率自适应调整风险敞口
cons_en: Parabolic SAR frequently reverses in ranging markets, generating numerous false signals and consecutive losses
Reliance on a single indicator lacks multi-dimensional confirmation, limiting trend identification reliability
Fixed lot sizing cannot adapt risk exposure based on market volatility
improvements: 增加ADX或ATR指标作为趋势强度过滤，在震荡行情中减少无效交易
引入动态仓位管理，根据ATR波动率或账户风险比例自动调整手数
improvements_en: Add ADX or ATR as a trend strength filter to reduce ineffective trades during ranging markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lots based on ATR volatility or account risk percentage

risk_points: SAR在震荡市中连续假信号可能导致多次止损累积亏损
若止损设置为0则存在无限亏损风险
时间过滤虽然减少交易次数但无法过滤时段内的震荡行情
risk_points_en: SAR consecutive false signals in ranging markets can accumulate losses through multiple stop-outs
Stop-loss set to 0 creates unlimited loss potential
Time filtering reduces trade frequency but cannot filter ranging conditions within allowed sessions
